name: testglass
description: Generate a human-reviewable test specification (HTML, Markdown, CSV) from Vitest and Playwright tests by static analysis
author: Tora29 (https://github.com/Tora29)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('src/output/html/assets','dist/output/html/assets',{recursive:true})" && node dist/cli.js schema --out dist/schema.json
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js --root test/fixtures --out demo/spec.json && node dist/cli.js --root examples/en --out demo/en/spec.json --lang en
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run demo
